text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, an appreciation party hosted by Tracen Academy was held.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not only academy staff, but also sponsoring companies and affiliated event production partners were invited to this glamorous banquet—and on the way home...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, look, a ramen shop♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, Hello-san.
Shall we stop by for a finishing bowl?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
I've been wanting to catch my breath!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: *sluuuuurp*... *slurp*.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: *haa*, *blow*, *blow*...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Haa. Delicious.
Lavish banquets are nice and all, but this really hits the spot.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It really warms the soul...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Coming here just brings peace of mind, doesn't it?
So whenever something happens, I end up stopping by. It's like my safe haven, or rather—
choice_data_list: You just end up dropping in a bit too often...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and then onto the scale—urgh!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but I understand.
Ramen brings such comfort, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: No matter how tense you are, stopping by here helps you unwind.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...! Exactly, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: No matter when or where I eat it, it's so comforting...—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Just remembering the past.
Thinking about how often I used to eat this back then.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...During my active racing days, I definitely wasn't on the winning side.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I have far more memories of leaving the racecourses in tears.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: On the way home, I'd stop at local ramen shops across the country, slurping their regional noodles while telling myself, "Next time for sure!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Even if those are bitter memories... they're still the fuel that keeps me moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Because right now, I'm having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
This must be my true calling.
The busier I get, the more fired up I feel!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: It feels as if—my heart has become young again.
choice_data_list: A true calling that makes the heart feel young...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Working hand in hand with horse girls—
supporting them while constantly being amazed by their brilliance day after day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, through them, it feels like reliving my own youth.
Experiencing that "passion" once again.
choice_data_list: ...To me, being a Trainer is my true calling.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: A true calling, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad. Glad that you feel that way, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I, too, believe my current job is my true calling.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
People often call it being an unsung hero.
Yet... I take pride in that.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It's true that a supporting role isn't somewhere bathed in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, everyone!
Keep up the great work this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Turf's growing well.
Yep, this should make for good running.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Gate repairs finished!
Alright, anyone who hasn't done the gate test yet, go ahead and practice~!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
"You'll be fine, you've got this...!"
"Just like always, you can do it...!"
"Give it your all...!"

text_block_list.name: Live Stage Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, showtime!
Go knock 'em dead...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Passing the baton behind the scenes.
To keep running alongside everyone as part of that support...
It makes me so very proud.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: In a way—I too am right in the middle of my youth♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving the ramen shop, we exchanged a silent handshake.
choice_data_list: Tomorrow, we'll give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we shall return here again.
To slurp down a bowl and share in our youth together.
